title: Steam Deck GPU Equivalent: LCD and OLED vs Desktop and iGPUs
description: The Steam Deck's 8-CU RDNA 2 GPU, about 1.6 TFLOPS, roughly equals a desktop GTX 1050, between a Radeon 660M and 680M iGPU. The OLED performs about the same.
dek: The closest desktop graphics card, integrated GPU and processor to Valve's Steam Deck LCD and OLED, worked out from the published specs, and what beats it.
quickAnswer: The Steam Deck's GPU (8 RDNA 2 compute units at 1.0 to 1.6 GHz, up to about 1.6 TFLOPS) performs roughly like a desktop GTX 1050 or Arc A310. Among integrated graphics it sits between a Radeon 660M and a Radeon 680M, near a Radeon 760M at low power. The Steam Deck OLED uses a die-shrunk version of the same chip with faster memory, so its GPU equivalent is about the same.
intro: Valve published the Steam Deck's key specs. Its custom AMD APU has a 4-core, 8-thread Zen 2 CPU at 2.4 to 3.5 GHz and an RDNA 2 GPU with 8 compute units at 1.0 to 1.6 GHz, sharing 16 GB of LPDDR5 within a 4 to 15 W power budget. The OLED model, launched in late 2023, moves the chip to a 6 nm process and the memory from 5,500 to 6,400 MT/s. This page matches both to the desktop GPU, integrated GPU and CPU that perform most like them.

These are rough, widely reported equivalents, built from the published specs and from how comparable RDNA 2 and RDNA 3 graphics perform in independent reviews. We have not tested a Steam Deck. A handheld's power mode changes its performance more than most PC parts, so treat each match as a range.

sections.h: How We Matched the Steam Deck to Desktop Parts
body: The Steam Deck's GPU is RDNA 2, the architecture of the Radeon RX 6000 series and the Radeon 680M and 660M laptop iGPUs. No desktop RX 6000 card is that small: the smallest, the RX 6400, has 12 compute units and its own memory. So the closest matches are the RDNA 2 and RDNA 3 integrated GPUs, and older desktop cards with similar throughput.

Eight compute units at up to 1.6 GHz is about 1.6 TFLOPS, close to a desktop GTX 1050's paper figure. Independent tests of the same games on the Deck and on low-end PCs broadly agree that it plays like a GTX 1050 or Arc A310, well below a GTX 1650. Roughly means within about 10 to 15 percent on average, a wider band than for desktop cards because the Deck shares its small power budget between CPU and GPU.

Memory is the other limit. The GPU shares 16 GB of LPDDR5 with the CPU at about 88 GB/s on the LCD model and about 102 GB/s on the OLED, far less than any desktop card with its own GDDR6. That is one reason the Deck targets its 1280 x 800 screen rather than 1080p.

sections.h: What Is the Steam Deck GPU Equivalent?
body: The Steam Deck GPU's closest desktop equivalent is roughly a GeForce GTX 1050 or an Arc A310. That is an entry-level card from 2016, and it fits the Deck's job: 1280 x 800 at low to medium settings in recent games, higher in older and lighter ones, often with FSR upscaling.

On the AMD side there is no desktop RDNA 2 card this small, so the honest match is an older Radeon RX 560 class card by performance. Any current desktop graphics card is several times faster. Even the [RX 6600](/gear/rx-6600/), one of the cheapest current 8 GB cards, is far ahead.
With ray tracing, the Deck's RDNA 2 hardware can technically run it, but in demanding games the cost is too high for a GPU this size. Treat it as a raster-only machine.

sections.h: How Does the Steam Deck Compare With Integrated Graphics?
body: Among integrated GPUs, the Steam Deck sits between a Radeon 660M (6 RDNA 2 compute units) and a Radeon 680M (12 RDNA 2 compute units). Its 8 units at up to 1.6 GHz put it closer to the 660M on paper, but the Deck's fixed hardware and SteamOS tuning help it in practice. A Radeon 760M, with 8 RDNA 3 compute units, is a close match at low laptop power and a little faster when given more.

The Radeon 780M, in the Ryzen 7 8700G desktop APU and many thin laptops, is clearly faster than a Deck, roughly between a GTX 1050 Ti and a GTX 1650 depending on power. Intel's Iris Xe with 96 EUs is somewhat slower than a Deck, while the Arc iGPU in Core Ultra laptops is roughly level or faster.

Older Vega 8 and Vega 7 graphics, in chips like the Ryzen 5 5600G, are slower than a Steam Deck. The [integrated graphics equivalents chart](/integrated-graphics-equivalents/) has every one of these matched to a desktop card.

sections.h: Steam Deck LCD vs OLED: Is the OLED GPU Faster?
body: Only slightly, if at all. The OLED's APU is the same design with the same 8 compute units and 4 CPU cores, made on a 6 nm process instead of 7 nm. Its memory runs at 6,400 MT/s instead of 5,500, which helps a little in memory-bound games, and the more efficient chip helps battery life more than frame rates.

The bigger OLED changes are the screen (7.4 inches, HDR, up to 90 Hz, at the same 1280 x 800 resolution) and the 50 Wh battery against the LCD's 40 Wh. For GPU equivalence, treat the two as the same: roughly a GTX 1050.

sections.h: What Is the Steam Deck CPU Equivalent?
body: The Steam Deck CPU is a 4-core, 8-thread AMD Zen 2 design at 2.4 to 3.5 GHz, sharing its power budget with the GPU. It performs roughly like a low-power laptop Ryzen 5 3500U or Ryzen 3 5300U, and below a desktop Ryzen 3 3100. In Intel terms, it lands near a laptop Core i5-8250U to i5-10210U.

That is enough for the Deck's 30 to 60 fps targets in most games, but CPU-heavy games, such as large strategy and simulation titles, can be limited by it. Any current desktop CPU, such as a [Ryzen 5 7600](/gear/ryzen-5-7600/), is several times faster.

sections.h: Steam Deck vs ROG Ally, Switch 2 and Steam Machine
body: The Z1 Extreme handhelds (ROG Ally, Ally X, Legion Go) have 12 RDNA 3 compute units, the same graphics as a Radeon 780M. At their higher power settings they run many games roughly 1.5 to 2 times as fast as a Deck, landing near a GTX 1650; at 15 W the gap shrinks a lot. The Z2 Extreme in the ROG Xbox Ally X is a modest step above that.

Valve says the Steam Machine is more than six times as powerful as the Steam Deck: 28 RDNA 3 compute units and dedicated GDDR6, roughly an RX 6600 XT. See [Steam Machine GPU equivalent](/steam-machine-gpu-equivalent/). The Nintendo Switch 2 is roughly level with or a little above a Deck in handheld mode and clearly ahead docked, by widely reported figures. Every console and handheld is in the [console GPU equivalents chart](/console-gpu-equivalents/). For those devices in detail, see the [ROG Ally GPU equivalent](/rog-ally-gpu-equivalent/) and [Switch 2 GPU equivalent](/switch-2-gpu-equivalent/) pages.

sections.h: What PC Beats a Steam Deck?
body: Almost any gaming PC from the last several years. A desktop with a GTX 1650 or better and a 4-core or 6-core CPU already beats a Deck at the same settings, and any current card is in a different class: an [RX 6600](/gear/rx-6600/) at $180 to $230 is several times faster, and an [Arc B580](/gear/arc-b580/) or [RTX 5060](/gear/rtx-5060/) more again.

A laptop or mini PC with a Radeon 780M or 890M also beats it, if the chip is given enough power. If you want a PC that plays the same Steam library on a TV, look at the Steam Machine or a small desktop with a current card; the [best budget graphics cards](/best-budget-graphics-card/) list ranks the cheaper options.

mistakes: Expecting the OLED to be a faster GPU
The Steam Deck OLED has the same 8 compute units on a smaller process, with slightly faster memory. It runs cooler and lasts longer, but its GPU equivalent is still roughly a GTX 1050.
The Deck renders for a 1280 x 800 screen, about half the pixels of 1080p. A desktop GTX 1050 tested at 1080p will look slower than a Deck playing the same game at its native resolution.
The Deck's APU shares 4 to 15 W between CPU and GPU. A game capped at a low TDP for battery life performs well below the GTX 1050 match; at full power it is closer.
Matching it to an RX 6000 card by name
The Deck uses RDNA 2 graphics, but with 8 compute units it is far below the smallest desktop RX 6000 card. Match it by performance, not by architecture name.
bottomLine: The Steam Deck's GPU, 8 RDNA 2 compute units at up to 1.6 GHz and about 1.6 TFLOPS, is roughly a desktop GTX 1050 or Arc A310. Among integrated graphics it sits between a Radeon 660M and a Radeon 680M, near a 760M at low power, and below a 780M. The OLED model uses the same GPU on a 6 nm process with faster memory, so its match is about the same. The 4-core Zen 2 CPU is roughly a laptop Ryzen 5 3500U. Any current desktop card, even an RX 6600, is several times faster.

faqs.q: What GPU is the Steam Deck equivalent to?
faqs.a: Roughly a desktop GTX 1050 or Arc A310. The Steam Deck has 8 RDNA 2 compute units at 1.0 to 1.6 GHz, about 1.6 TFLOPS, sharing 16 GB of LPDDR5 with the CPU.

faqs.q: Is the Steam Deck OLED GPU better than the LCD?
faqs.a: Only slightly. It is the same 8-CU RDNA 2 GPU on a 6 nm process with faster 6,400 MT/s memory. The gains show mainly in battery life and temperatures, not frame rates.

faqs.q: What integrated graphics is the Steam Deck equivalent to?
faqs.a: It sits between a Radeon 660M and a Radeon 680M, and near a Radeon 760M at low power. A Radeon 780M is clearly faster; Intel Iris Xe 96 EU is somewhat slower.

faqs.q: Is the Steam Deck better than a GTX 1650?
faqs.a: No. A GTX 1650 is clearly faster, roughly where the Z1 Extreme handhelds land at their higher power settings. The Deck is closer to a GTX 1050.

faqs.q: What CPU is the Steam Deck equivalent to?
faqs.a: A low-power laptop Ryzen 5 3500U or Ryzen 3 5300U: 4 Zen 2 cores and 8 threads at 2.4 to 3.5 GHz. It is below a desktop Ryzen 3 3100.

faqs.q: How many TFLOPS is the Steam Deck?
faqs.a: Up to about 1.6 TFLOPS, from 8 compute units at 1.6 GHz. That is about a sixth of a PS5's 10.3 TFLOPS.

faqs.q: Is the ROG Ally faster than the Steam Deck?
faqs.a: Yes, at its higher power settings: the Z1 Extreme's 12 RDNA 3 compute units run many games roughly 1.5 to 2 times as fast. At 15 W the two are much closer.

faqs.q: How much faster is the Steam Machine than the Steam Deck?
faqs.a: Valve says more than six times. The Steam Machine's 28-CU RDNA 3 GPU with dedicated GDDR6 lands roughly at an RX 6600 XT, against a GTX 1050 for the Deck.
